mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% from the prior month's level signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month moving averages signals a contraction in aggregate demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate monetary policy easing.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 210.0 index level signals an overheating economy, triggering central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising RSAFS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% from the prior month's level signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending power and triggers negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized and a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 550.0 thousand units signals an economic slowdown that prompts central bank stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
